scripts.dev: bunx concurrently -n main,docs -c red,gray "bun run --cwd main-site dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4321" "bun run --cwd docs-site dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4322"

scripts.check: bun run --cwd main-site astro check && bun run --cwd docs-site astro check
